Q5786.reason: Post-injury refusal limits recovery under avoidable consequences to the wound and pain before the refusal; it is not contributory negligence and does not wipe out the original injury.

Q5253.reason: The burglary fragment does not match these interests; among them only a grantor’s reversion is outside the Rule Against Perpetuities.

Q5347.reason: Existing intramuscular ATP powers roughly the first 1–2 seconds of maximal force; phosphocreatine and glycolysis only regenerate ATP after that.
